verdict: ServiceNow: Choose ServiceNow when enterprise ITSM (and likely adjacent Now modules) is the job and you can run an RFP — not when you need Freshservice’s published Starter SKU. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
bestFor: Enterprises standardising ITSM (and often HRSD/CSM) on one platform
ITIL-mature shops that need CMDB + change at scale
Buyers with budget for implementation partners
notIdealFor: SMBs that need a published $19/agent ITSM SKU (Freshservice)
Atlassian-first teams that only need JSM on an existing Jira Cloud
SRE teams buying observability (Datadog / New Relic)
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors
Free tiers vs enterprise SSO/audit gates
Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose ServiceNow when enterprise ITSM (and likely adjacent Now modules) is the job and you can run an RFP — not when you need Freshservice’s published Starter SKU. Compare Freshservice for published mid-market ITSM; Jira Service Management if you already live in Jira Cloud.
editorialNotes: IT Priority-2 batch. Approved on it-development-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=itsm-service-desk. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Enterprise platform UX and implementation burden — productive after SI/config, not in an afternoon. Not hands-on lab tested.
Canonical enterprise ITSM — ranked with Freshservice and JSM, not against Datadog or GitHub.
ITIL-depth CMDB, change, and cross-module workflows are the category ceiling.
Broadest enterprise integration surface in the ITSM cluster.
Enterprise controls, domain separation, and compliance are core.
Built for global fulfiller counts and multi-module estates.
Quote-only + implementation is the TCO story; not comparable to $19 Freshservice Starter. Affiliate economics excluded.
Now Assist bundled by 2026 tier; Prime gates custom agents. Scored as assistance, not a ChatGPT substitute.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
